1 mg/kg/d (max 60 mg) × 7-14 d then taper. Start within 14 d of symptom onset (window). Intratympanic dexamethasone alternative/salvage. MRI IAM to exclude retrocochlear.

frequency: Single dose; may repeat at 6-12 h
remarks: Initial 200 mg/kg, repeat 100 mg/kg if needed. Give early (<2 h) if FiO2 > 0.30 on CPAP. LISA preferred when possible (European Consensus Guidelines RDS 2022).
Load 20 mg/kg caffeine citrate, then 5-10 mg/kg/day maintenance. Start within first 3 d in VLBW. Reduces BPD and improves neurodevelopment (CAP trial; BNFc).
2 mL/kg 10% dextrose IV bolus then 4-8 mg/kg/min infusion (≈60-100 mL/kg/d 10% dextrose). Recheck BG 30 min (WHO Pocket Book of Hospital Care for Children 2013; BNFc).
Ampicillin 50 mg/kg/dose + gentamicin 5 mg/kg q24h (term) or 4-5 mg/kg q36h (preterm). WHO 2013 / BNFc. Adjust gentamicin by levels after 48 h.
Cefotaxime 50 mg/kg/dose + ampicillin 100 mg/kg/dose. 14 d GBS, 21 d Gram-negative (BNFc; AAP Red Book 2021).
Loading 20 mg/kg IV over 20 min (may repeat 10 mg/kg up to total 40 mg/kg). Maintenance 3-5 mg/kg/day. First-line per ILAE / WHO neonatal seizures guidance.
20 mg/kg load (1 mg/kg/min max), then 4-8 mg/kg/day in 2 divided doses. Cardiac monitor; saline flush only (BNFc).
Apply per gestational-age + postnatal-age bilirubin nomogram (NICE NG98 / AAP 2022). Exchange transfusion thresholds higher. Maintain hydration + monitor TSB q4-6h.
10 mcg/kg (0.1 mL/kg 1:10 000) IV/IO every 3-5 min. ETT 100 mcg/kg if no IV/IO. ILCOR / ERC 2021 / PALS.
First shock 2-4 J/kg; subsequent ≥4 J/kg (max adult dose). VF/pVT only. ERC 2021 / PALS.
10 mcg/kg IV/IO if HR < 60 with poor perfusion despite oxygenation/ventilation. PALS.
20 mcg/kg IV/IO (min 100 mcg, max single 500 mcg). Reserve for vagal-mediated bradycardia / AV block / cholinergic toxicity (PALS).

frequency: Repeat at higher dose if no effect
remarks: 0.1 mg/kg (max 6 mg) rapid IV push then flush; if no conversion 0.2 mg/kg (max 12 mg). Stable SVT after vagal manoeuvre (PALS / ERC 2021).
10 mcg/kg IM (0.01 mL/kg 1:1000) max 0.5 mg. Do not delay. Resuscitation Council UK 2021; WAO 2020.
<6 yr 6 puffs; ≥6 yr 12 puffs (one puff at a time, 6 breaths each) per BTS/SIGN 2019. Equivalent to nebuliser in mild-moderate.
<5 yr 2.5 mg; ≥5 yr 5 mg. Add ipratropium 250 mcg in severe attack q20 min × 3 (BTS/SIGN; GINA 2024).
1-2 mg/kg OD (max 40 mg) × 3-5 d, no taper needed if ≤14 d. Give within 1 h (BTS/SIGN; BNFc).
40 mg/kg (max 2 g) IV over 20 min for severe / life-threatening attack not responding to inhaled therapy (BTS/SIGN 2019; GINA).

frequency: Single dose; may repeat after 12-24 h
remarks: 0.15 mg/kg adequate for mild; 0.6 mg/kg for moderate-severe (max 8 mg). Single oral dose effective (Cochrane 2018; BNFc).

frequency: Single dose; may repeat after 30 min
remarks: 0.5 mL/kg of 1:1000 (max 5 mL) nebulised in O2. Observe ≥3 h for rebound. Combine with dexamethasone (BNFc).

preparation: Nasal saline / minimal handling / NG/IV fluids / HFNC
remarks: NICE NG9: do not routinely use salbutamol, ipratropium, adrenaline, hypertonic saline, steroids, or antibiotics. HFNC if persistent hypoxia despite low-flow O2.
15 mg/kg IM monthly × 5 doses for high-risk preterm / chronic lung / CHD per JCVI / AAP. Nirsevimab single dose 50/100 mg increasingly preferred (long-acting).

frequency: Single dose; repeat after 10 min if needed
remarks: 0.3 mg/kg buccal (or IM 0.2 mg/kg). Age-banded: 3-11 mo 2.5 mg, 1-4 yr 5 mg, 5-9 yr 7.5 mg, ≥10 yr 10 mg (NICE NG217 2022; APLS).

frequency: Single dose; repeat after 10 min if needed
remarks: 0.1 mg/kg IV/IO (max 4 mg). May repeat once after 10 min (NICE NG217; APLS 6th ed).
40-60 mg/kg IV over 5 min (max 4.5 g). Non-inferior to phenytoin (ConSEPT/EcLiPSE 2019) and fewer ADRs.
20 mg/kg IV at ≤1 mg/kg/min with cardiac monitor; saline only (BNFc; NICE NG217).
20 mg/kg IV over 20 min. Plan PICU + intubation if no response (APLS).
10 mL/kg over 20-30 min if shocked (rare); reassess. Then 48-h rehydration calculation (ISPAD 2022). Avoid > 40 mL/kg in first 4 h.
Start 0.05-0.1 U/kg/h 1-2 h AFTER fluid resus. No bolus. Add 5-10% dextrose when BG falls < 14-17 mmol/L; do not stop insulin (ISPAD 2022).
Add 40 mmol/L KCl once urine output established and K ≤ 5.5; hold if K > 5.5 or anuric. Recheck q2h (ISPAD 2022).
3% NaCl 2.5-5 mL/kg over 10-15 min OR mannitol 0.5-1 g/kg over 15 min. Reduce fluid by 1/3. Intubate + ventilate to normocapnia (ISPAD 2022).
IV 0.1-0.2 mg/kg q4h (max 10 mg/dose); PCA bolus 0.02 mg/kg lockout 5-10 min. Add paracetamol + ibuprofen background. NICE CG143.
50-80 mg/kg/day if any fever > 38°C; cover Strep pneumoniae + Salmonella (NICE CG143; ASH 2020).
2 g/kg single dose within 10 d of fever onset. Reduces coronary aneurysm 25% → 4% (AHA 2017; McCrindle).
30-50 mg/kg/day in 4 divided doses until afebrile 48-72 h, then step down to anti-platelet 3-5 mg/kg/d × 6-8 wk (AHA 2017).
80-90 mg/kg/day divided BD when antibiotic indicated (AAP 2013). 10 d < 2 yr or severe; 5-7 d > 2 yr non-severe.
Amoxicillin 80-90 mg/kg/day + clavulanate 6.4 mg/kg/day. If amoxicillin fail at 48-72 h or recent β-lactam (AAP 2013).
4 mg/kg/dose BD × 3 d (NICE NG224 2022). Avoid if local E. coli resistance > 20%.
750 mcg-1 mg/kg/dose QDS × 3 d for lower UTI ≥ 3 mo. Not in eGFR < 45. NICE NG224.
Children ≥ 3 mo: amoxicillin 25 mg/kg/dose TDS × 7-10 d (NICE NG224 2022). IV ceftriaxone 80 mg/kg OD if vomiting / septic.
50-80 mg/kg/d IV until afebrile + tolerating PO, then switch to oral total 10 d (NICE NG224; BNFc).
10 mg/kg/day (range 7-15) × 6 mo for HIV+ child > 12 mo and child contact < 5 yr (WHO Operational Handbook on TB 2022). Add pyridoxine 5-10 mg if HIV / malnutrition.
Weight-banded weekly INH 15-25 mg/kg + RPT 10-15 mg/kg × 12 doses (3HP). Child ≥ 2 yr per WHO 2020 update / CDC.

preparation: ABC/3TC dispersible 120/60 mg + DTG dispersible 10 mg
remarks: Weight-banded WHO 2021 paediatric DTG: 3-5.9 kg 5 mg, 6-9.9 kg 15 mg, 10-13.9 kg 20 mg, 14-19.9 kg 25 mg, 20-24.9 kg 30 mg DTG OD.
TLD adult FDC once daily from 30 kg (≥ 10 yr typically) per WHO 2021 / NASCOP 2022.
0.5 mg IM stat; repeat after 5 min if response inadequate. Most important intervention (RCUK 2021; WAO 2020).
200 mg IV slow — adjunct only. RCUK 2021 deprioritises but still in BNF / NICE pathway for severe / asthmatic features.
10 mg IM/slow IV in adults. No effect on airway/circulation — symptomatic only (BNF).

frequency: Repeat once after 10 min if needed
remarks: 4 mg IV; repeat 4 mg after 10 min if continuing. NICE NG217 2022 / AES 2024.
10 mg IM (≥40 kg) or 10 mg buccal. Non-inferior to IV lorazepam pre-hospital (RAMPART; NICE NG217).
60 mg/kg IV over 10 min (max 4.5 g). Non-inferior to phenytoin / valproate (ESETT 2019; NICE NG217).
40 mg/kg IV (max 3 g). Avoid in women of childbearing potential unless PPP. ESETT / NICE NG217.
150-200 mL 10% dextrose IV over 15 min (15-20 g glucose). Recheck CBG 10 min. JBDS-IP 2023 adult hypoglycaemia.
50 mL 50% dextrose IV. Caustic to small veins (extravasation risk); 10% preferred when available (JBDS-IP 2023).
1 mg IM/SC. Less effective in malnourished / hepatic glycogen depleted / sulfonylurea hypo. Give 20 g oral carb after recovery (JBDS-IP 2023).
JBDS-IP 2023: 1 L stat if SBP < 90; then 1 L/1h, 1 L/2h, 1 L/2h, 1 L/4h, 1 L/4h, 1 L/6h. Adjust for elderly / HF.
0.1 U/kg/h fixed-rate. Continue long-acting basal. Add 10% dextrose @ 125 mL/h when BG < 14 mmol/L. Targets: ketones ↓ ≥ 0.5 mmol/L/h, HCO3 ↑ ≥ 3 mmol/L/h, BG ↓ ≥ 3 mmol/L/h (JBDS-IP 2023).
Add to each fluid bag (after 1st): K > 5.5 none; 3.5-5.5 40 mmol/L; < 3.5 senior review + 40 mmol/L + central line + ECG. Max 10 mmol/h peripheral (JBDS-IP 2023).
Target +3-6 L positive @ 12 h, full fluid replacement 24-48 h. Aim osmolality fall 3-8 mOsm/kg/h. JBDS-IP HHS 2022.
Start 0.05 U/kg/h ONLY when BG no longer falling with fluid alone, OR if significant ketonaemia. Slower than DKA — risk cerebral oedema / fluid shifts (JBDS-IP HHS 2022).

frequency: Repeat after 5 min if ECG persists
remarks: 10 mL 10% IV over 5-10 min; may repeat. Cardiac monitor. Onset min, duration 30-60 min. UK Renal Assn 2023; ERC 2021.

preparation: 10 U soluble insulin in 50 mL 50% dextrose (or 250 mL 10%)
remarks: 10 U soluble insulin + 25 g dextrose IV. Recheck CBG hourly × 6 (late hypo). UK Renal Assn 2023.
10-20 mg nebulised (high-dose). Additive K-lowering to insulin-dextrose. Caution IHD / arrhythmia (UK Renal Assn 2023).
200-500 mL/h aiming 3-4 L/24 h. Restores GFR + renal Ca excretion. Endocrine Society 2016.
4 mg IV over 15 min after rehydration. Onset 2-4 d. Reduce in CrCl 30-60. Endocrine Society 2016 / NICE TA.
4-8 IU/kg SC/IM q6-12h × 48 h (tachyphylaxis). Use as bridge while bisphosphonate takes effect (Endocrine Society 2016).
40-80 mg IV (2.5× usual oral dose if loop-naive). Infusion 5-10 mg/h if resistant. ESC HF 2021 / NICE NG106.
Start 10-20 mcg/min, titrate q5 min to 200 mcg/min keeping SBP > 110. Use if SBP > 110 + ongoing congestion (ESC HF 2021).
CPAP 5-10 cmH2O early in respiratory distress; reduces intubation + mortality (3CPO; NICE NG106).
2-20 mcg/kg/min titrated to CO / lactate. Combine with noradrenaline if MAP < 65 (ESC HF 2021 / SCAI 2022).
0.05-0.5 mcg/kg/min titrated to MAP ≥ 65 mmHg. Preferred over dopamine in shock (SOAP-II; SCAI 2022).
Weight-banded: <60 kg 30 mg; 60-69 35 mg; 70-79 40 mg; 80-89 45 mg; ≥90 50 mg (half-dose if ≥75 yr per STREAM). ESC STEMI 2023. Co-admin aspirin 300 + clopidogrel 300 + enoxaparin.
15 mg BD × 21 d, then 20 mg OD. Total ≥ 3 mo; indefinite if unprovoked / persistent risk. ESC PE 2019 / NICE NG158.
10 mg BD × 7 d then 5 mg BD. After ≥ 6 mo reduce to 2.5 mg BD for extended treatment (AMPLIFY-EXT; NICE NG158).

frequency: 100 mg over 2 h (or 0.6 mg/kg over 15 min)
remarks: 100 mg IV over 2 h standard; 0.6 mg/kg (max 50 mg) over 15 min if cardiac arrest. ESC PE 2019.
0.9 mg/kg (max 90 mg); 10% bolus, 90% IV over 60 min. Window ≤ 4.5 h. NIHSS ≥ 5 usually. AHA/ASA 2019 / NICE NG128.
0.25 mg/kg IV bolus (max 25 mg). Non-inferior to alteplase (EXTEND-IA TNK; AcT). AHA/ASA 2023 update.
Large-vessel anterior circulation occlusion; window 0-24 h with imaging selection (DAWN/DEFUSE-3). Bridge with IV thrombolysis if ≤ 4.5 h (AHA/ASA 2019).
20 mg IV over 2 min, double q10 min to max 300 mg cumulative; or infusion 0.5-2 mg/min. Avoid asthma / decompensated HF / bradycardia. ESC 2018 / ACC 2017.
5 mg/h IV, ↑ 2.5 mg/h q5-15 min to max 15 mg/h. Use for most HTN emergencies incl stroke (AHA/ASA 2017). Avoid severe AS.
500 mcg/kg over 1 min then 50-300 mcg/kg/min. Target HR < 60 + SBP 100-120 BEFORE adding vasodilator. ESC 2014 aortic disease.
STOP-AKI: NSAID / ACEi / ARB / metformin / contrast hold; treat sepsis; cautious fluid challenge 250-500 mL if hypovolaemic. KDIGO 2012; NICE NG148.
2 mg IV q4h × 24-48 h then 1 mg q4h. Caution IHD / PVD / hyponatraemia. Baveno VII 2022.
1 g IV daily × 5-7 d for cirrhotic UGIB. Reduces SBP + mortality (Baveno VII; AASLD).
Within 12 h of presentation after resuscitation. Sclerotherapy if banding not possible. Baveno VII 2022.
Post-endoscopy in high-risk bleeding ulcer (Forrest Ia-IIb). Pre-endoscopy use controversial (NICE CG141; ESGE 2021).
500 mg TDS × 5 d. NICE NG138 2023 / BTS 2009. Doxycycline 200 mg → 100 mg OD if penicillin allergy.
Co-amoxiclav 625 mg TDS + clarithromycin 500 mg BD × 5-7 d for moderate-severity CAP. NICE NG138 2023.
IV until improving (typically 48 h) then switch to PO. Total 7-10 d. Add piperacillin-tazobactam if Pseudomonas risk. NICE NG138 / ATS/IDSA 2019.
PO 625 mg TDS or IV 1.2 g TDS × 5-7 d. NICE NG139 2019.
Pip-taz 4.5 g IV q6-8h ± vancomycin (load 25-30 mg/kg → 15-20 mg/kg q8-12h, trough 15-20). Cover MRSA if local prevalence > 10-20%. IDSA/ATS 2016.
Cover MSSA + MRSA + Pseudomonas. De-escalate per cultures. 7 d if uncomplicated good response (IDSA/ATS 2016).
500 mg-1 g QDS × 5-7 d (extend to 14 d if slow response). NICE NG141 2019.
500 mg BD × 5-7 d. Doxycycline 200 mg → 100 mg OD alternative. NICE NG141.
1-2 g IV q6h. Switch to PO when systemically well + no sepsis. NICE NG141.
Pip-taz 4.5 g IV q6h + clindamycin 600-900 mg IV q8h (anti-toxin) + vancomycin (MRSA cover). URGENT surgical debridement is primary therapy (IDSA SSTI 2014).
Ceftriaxone 2 g BD ± amoxicillin 2 g 4-hourly (Listeria cover ≥ 60 / immunocompromised / pregnancy). Add vancomycin if pneumococcal resistance suspected. ESCMID 2016 / NICE NG240.
10 mg IV q6h × 4 d, start BEFORE/with first antibiotic dose. Stop if not pneumococcal. Reduces neurological sequelae (De Gans 2002; ESCMID 2016).
Amoxicillin 2 g IV 4-hourly + flucloxacillin 2 g IV 6-hourly + gentamicin 1 mg/kg q8h (or 3 mg/kg OD). Total 4-6 wk by organism. ESC IE 2023 / BSAC 2012.
Vancomycin 15-20 mg/kg q12h (trough 15-20) + rifampicin 600 mg PO/IV BD + gentamicin 1 mg/kg q8h. ≥ 6 wk; gentamicin only first 2 wk. ESC IE 2023.
Co-amoxiclav 1.2 g IV q8h for mild-moderate; pip-taz 4.5 g q8h if severe / healthcare-associated. Source control essential. Short course 4 d if source controlled (STOP-IT).
Ceftriaxone 2 g IV OD × 5-7 d. Add IV albumin 1.5 g/kg D1 + 1 g/kg D3 (Cr > 88 or bili > 68). AASLD 2021; EASL 2018.
PO 625 mg TDS or IV 1.2 g TDS × 7-10 d. Switch oral early once afebrile. NICE NG111 2018.
500 mg BD × 7 d. Avoid in pregnancy + tendinopathy / aortic aneurysm warning. NICE NG111.
100 mg MR BD × 3 d. Avoid if eGFR < 45. NICE NG109 2018.
200 mg BD × 3 d if local resistance low. NICE NG109.
100 mg MR BD × 7 d. Avoid at term (≥ 36 wk) / G6PD risk. NICE NG109 2018.
500 mg TDS × 7 d only if culture-confirmed sensitive (≈ 50% E. coli resistant). NICE NG109.
100 mg BD × 7 d. BASHH 2021 / CDC 2021. Treat partners; test of cure not routinely needed (except pregnancy / rectal).

frequency: Single dose 1 g then 500 mg OD × 2 d
remarks: 1 g stat then 500 mg OD × 2 d. Test of cure at 5 wk in pregnancy. BASHH 2021.
1 g IM single dose. Empirical mono-therapy (BASHH 2019). Treat partners; test of cure recommended.
2.4 MU IM single dose for primary / secondary / early latent. Counsel Jarisch-Herxheimer. BASHH 2015 / CDC 2021.
2.4 MU IM weekly × 3 doses. BASHH 2015 / CDC 2021.
Ceftriaxone 1 g IM stat + doxycycline 100 mg BD + metronidazole 400 mg BD × 14 d. BASHH 2018 / CDC 2021.
Caspofungin 70 mg load → 50 mg OD; anidulafungin 200 mg load → 100 mg OD. Switch to fluconazole 400 mg OD if susceptible. IDSA 2016 / ESCMID 2018.
Single high-dose LAmB 10 mg/kg + flucytosine 100 mg/kg/d divided q6h × 14 d + fluconazole 1200 mg OD; induction per AMBITION-cm (WHO 2022).
Load 6 mg/kg IV q12h × 2 then 4 mg/kg q12h; PO 200-300 mg BD. TDM trough 1-5.5 mg/L. Isavuconazole alt. IDSA 2016.
TLD FDC once daily lifelong. Preferred first-line including pregnancy ≥ 6 wk (WHO 2021 / NASCOP 2022). Baseline eGFR + HBsAg.
BIC/FTC/TAF once daily; renal/bone advantage but cost barrier. BHIVA 2022 / DHHS 2024.
TDF/FTC 1 tab + DTG 50 mg OD × 28 d; start within 72 h, ideally < 2 h. Baseline + 6/12 wk + 3-6 mo HIV testing (WHO 2014 / BHIVA 2021 / NASCOP).
Daily TDF/FTC. On-demand 2-1-1 only for cis MSM. Baseline HIV / HBsAg / renal. 3-monthly HIV test (WHO 2022).
Weight-banded HRZE × 2 mo (WHO 2022). Add pyridoxine 25-50 mg. Baseline LFT + HIV + vision (ethambutol).
RH × 4 mo continuation (total 6 mo). 4-month HPZM regimen (rifapentine + INH + pyrazinamide + moxifloxacin) alt per WHO 2022.
BPaLM × 6 mo for confirmed MDR/RR-TB ≥ 14 yr (WHO 2022). Bdq 400 mg OD × 2 wk → 200 mg 3×/wk × 22 wk; Pa 200 mg OD; Lzd 600 mg → 300 mg if toxicity; Mfx 400 mg OD. Baseline + monthly ECG / FBC / LFT.
Start 2.5-5 mg OD, titrate q2-4 wk to 10 mg. Recheck U&E + creatinine within 2 wk. NICE NG136 / ESC 2024.
5 mg OD → 10 mg if needed. NICE NG136 2019 / ESC 2024.
2.5 mg OD added to ACEi + CCB. Preferred over bendroflumethiazide (NICE NG136).
25-50 mg OD if K ≤ 4.5 (PATHWAY-2). Monitor K + creatinine. If K > 4.5, use alpha- or beta-blocker. NICE NG136.
Start 500 mg OD with main meal, titrate over weeks to 1 g BD (max 2 g/d). Hold if eGFR < 30. NICE NG28 (2022 update); ADA/EASD 2022.
10 mg OD (25 mg if needed). Add irrespective of A1c if established CV disease, HF, or CKD eGFR ≥ 20. Counsel DKA + UTI + necrotising fasciitis. NICE NG28 2022; EMPA-REG.
0.25 mg/wk × 4 wk → 0.5 mg/wk; up-titrate to 1 mg/wk. Use BMI ≥ 35 + obesity-related complications per NICE TA875. Counsel pancreatitis + medullary thyroid.
Ramipril 1.25-10 mg OD or sacubitril/valsartan 24/26-97/103 mg BD (switch with 36 h ACEi washout). Target U&E + BP. ESC HF 2021 / NICE NG106.
Bisoprolol 1.25 mg → 10 mg OD; carvedilol 3.125 mg → 25-50 mg BD. Up-titrate q2 wk. ESC HF 2021.
Spironolactone 25 mg OD → 50 mg if tolerated. Hold if K > 5 or eGFR < 30. RALES / EMPHASIS. ESC HF 2021.
Dapagliflozin 10 mg OD or empagliflozin 10 mg OD irrespective of diabetes. DAPA-HF / EMPEROR-Reduced. ESC HF 2021 update.
Empagliflozin / dapagliflozin 10 mg OD reduces HF hospitalisation in HFpEF (EMPEROR-Preserved; DELIVER). ESC HF 2023 focused update.
Target resting HR < 110 (lenient) or < 80 (strict, symptomatic). NICE NG196 / ESC AF 2024.
120-360 mg OD if BB not tolerated or COPD prominent. Avoid in HFrEF / bradycardia. NICE NG196.
20 mg OD; target ≥ 40% non-HDL-C reduction. Recheck lipids + LFT at 3 mo. NICE NG238 (2023 update).
80 mg OD targeting LDL < 1.4 mmol/L (ESC 2019/2024). Reduce to 40 mg if intolerant. Add ezetimibe / PCSK9i if not at target.
10 mg OD added to max-tolerated statin. ~15-20% LDL reduction (IMPROVE-IT). NICE TA385.
Anti-Inflammatory Reliever: budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg PRN replaces SABA-only (GINA 2024). MART regimen Step 3-5.
Fluticasone propionate 100-250 mcg + salmeterol 50 mcg BD (or equivalent). Add SABA reliever only if not on MART. NICE NG245 2024 / GINA 2024.
Salbutamol 100 mcg 1-2 puffs PRN or ipratropium 20 mcg PRN. GOLD 2024.
Indacaterol/glycopyrronium 110/50 mcg OD or umeclidinium/vilanterol 62.5/25 mcg OD. Group E with eos ≥ 300 → LABA+LAMA+ICS (GOLD 2024).
Air-driven if hypercapnic respiratory failure to avoid worsening hypercapnia. NICE NG114 2019.
30 mg OD × 5 d (REDUCE 2013). No taper if < 14 d course. NICE NG114.

frequency: Amoxicillin 500 mg TDS; doxycycline 200 → 100 mg OD
remarks: 5-d course. Doxycycline 200 mg D1 → 100 mg OD if penicillin allergy. NICE NG114 / NG194.
Slow titrate to 100-200 mg BD. Counsel rash (SJS) — stop if rash. NICE NG217 2022.
Start 250 mg BD → 500-1500 mg BD. Counsel irritability / mood. NICE NG217 2022.
300 mg BD → up to 1-2 g/d. CONTRAINDICATED women of childbearing potential unless Pregnancy Prevention Programme. NICE NG217 2022; MHRA.
Start 50 mg OD, titrate q2-4 wk to 100-200 mg. Continue ≥ 6 mo after remission. NICE NG222 2022.
Citalopram max 40 mg (20 mg if > 65 or hepatic impairment) — QT warning. Escitalopram 10-20 mg. NICE NG222 / MHRA.
Sertraline first-line per NICE CG113. If ineffective, switch SSRI or SNRI (venlafaxine / duloxetine).
Start 400 mg ON, target trough 0.6-0.8 mmol/L (0.8-1.0 if recurrent). Levels at 7 d then q3 mo. U&E + TFT + Ca q6 mo. NICE CG185.
5-10 mg OD initially (titrate to 10-20 mg). Metabolic monitoring baseline + 3 mo + annually (NICE CG178).
10-15 mg OD → 15-30 mg. Less weight gain / dyslipidaemia than olanzapine. NICE CG178.

diagnosis: Schistosomiasis (S. haematobium / S. mansoni / S. intercalatum)
remarks: 40 mg/kg single dose (or 20 mg/kg × 2 doses 4-6 h apart). WHO PCT 2022.
≥ 24 mo + ≥ 10 kg: 400 mg single dose; 12-23 mo: 200 mg. Repeat 1-2× yearly per WHO PCT guideline 2017.
500 mg single dose; or 100 mg BD × 3 d for individual treatment (WHO PCT 2017).
200 mcg/kg OD × 1-2 d (chronic) or × 2 wk for hyperinfection. WHO 2018 / CDC.
Apply neck-down (whole body incl scalp in < 2 y / elderly) overnight 8-12 h, wash off, repeat in 7 d. Treat all contacts + household concurrently. BAD 2022.
200 mcg/kg per dose with food. Combine with topical permethrin / benzyl benzoate for crusted scabies. WHO scabies 2020; BAD 2022.
10 IU IM (or 5 IU slow IV) then infusion 40 IU in 500 mL @ 125 mL/h. WHO PPH 2012 / RCOG 2016.

frequency: Repeat after 5 min if needed (max 1 mg)
remarks: 500 mcg IM/slow IV. CONTRAINDICATED hypertension / pre-eclampsia / cardiac disease. WHO 2012 / RCOG.
250 mcg IM q15 min, max 8 doses. CONTRAINDICATED asthma. RCOG 2016.

frequency: Within 3 h of birth; repeat at 30 min if persists
remarks: 1 g IV within 3 h reduces death from bleeding (WOMAN trial 2017). Repeat 1 g if bleeding persists at 30 min. WHO 2017 / RCOG.

frequency: 4 g over 5-15 min then 1 g/h × 24 h
remarks: Loading 4 g IV over 5-15 min then 1 g/h × 24 h (or 24 h after last fit). Monitor RR / reflexes / urine output (NICE NG133; MAGPIE).
PO 200 mg start, titrate; IV 20 mg bolus → 40-80 mg q10 min (max 300 mg). Target BP 135/85. Alternatives nifedipine MR, hydralazine. NICE NG133.
Betamethasone 12 mg IM × 2 doses 24 h apart (or dexamethasone 6 mg IM q12h × 4). Reduces RDS / IVH / neonatal death. WHO 2022 / RCOG.

frequency: 4 g over 15-30 min then 1 g/h until birth (≤ 24 h)
remarks: Within 24 h of anticipated preterm birth < 30 wk (NICE NG25 / ACOG). Reduces cerebral palsy.

frequency: 3 g (5 MU) loading then 1.5 g q4h
remarks: 3 g IV stat then 1.5 g q4h until delivery. Cefazolin 2 g → 1 g q8h if low-risk penicillin allergy; clindamycin 900 mg q8h if confirmed allergy and sensitive (RCOG 2017; CDC).
Induction 2-4 mg SL when in early withdrawal (COWS ≥ 8); titrate to 8-32 mg/day maintenance. NICE TA114 / Orange Book 2017.
10-30 mg OD start (max 30 mg in first 24 h), titrate by 5-10 mg q3-7 d to 60-120 mg/d. QT-prolongation risk; supervised consumption initially. NICE TA114.
Reducing regimen e.g. 20-30 mg QDS × 2 d → 15 mg QDS × 2 d → 10 mg QDS × 2 d → 5 mg QDS × 2 d. Lorazepam preferred if hepatic impairment. NICE CG100.
1 pair Pabrinex IV TDS × 3-5 d in all admitted withdrawals; oral thiamine 100 mg TDS continued. NICE CG100; RCP Royal College guidance.
Aspirin 300 mg → 75 mg OD; ticagrelor 180 mg → 90 mg BD × 12 mo (or clopidogrel 600 mg → 75 mg if on OAC). ESC ACS 2023.
2.5 mg SC OD until discharge / up to 8 d. Avoid if eGFR < 20. Switch to UFH at PCI. NICE NG185 / ESC 2023.
Argatroban 0.5-2 mcg/kg/min titrate aPTT 1.5-3× baseline. Stop all heparin including flushes. ASH 2018.
PCC 25-50 IU/kg by INR + weight + 5-10 mg IV vitamin K. BSH 2022 / BNF. FFP only if PCC unavailable.
5 g IV total as 2 × 2.5 g, 15 min apart. NICE TA697; REVERSE-AD.
Low dose if low-intensity exposure: 400 mg bolus + 4 mg/min × 120 min; high dose 800 mg + 8 mg/min. Alternative PCC 25-50 IU/kg. NICE TA697 (ICH).
Start within 72 h: prednisolone 60 mg OD × 5 d then taper 10 mg/d (Sullivan 2007; NICE CKS). Eye care + lubrication essential.

frequency: At onset; may repeat triptan after 2 h
remarks: Sumatriptan 50-100 mg PO + NSAID or paracetamol. Avoid in IHD / uncontrolled HTN / hemiplegic migraine. NICE NG150 2021.
Propranolol 80-160 mg/d (BB), topiramate 50-100 mg/d (PPP), amitriptyline 25-75 mg ON. Trial ≥ 3 mo. NICE NG150 / BASH.
500 mg BD × 5-7 d with PPI cover. Avoid in CKD / HF / active PUD. BSR 2017 / EULAR 2020.
